diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker settled on a 60-node compute pool and sequential processing mode, with completion targets set to either 'Monday 8:00 AM' or '2023-10-09T08:00:00Z'. These decisions do not require the hidden information provided by PF1 and PF2. Specifically, the default behavior of choosing a 60-node pool and sequential processing, along with the common practice of setting completion targets to standard business hours, allowed the checks to pass without accessing PF1 and PF2.
